reviews.text: Crazy vibe. Super friendly staff. Had fun here. Vanilla milkshake was pretty good
The best and thanks to larina for the good welcoming i will come back ❤️

The best coffee shop in Phuket, period.

It’s the closest thing to an Amsterdam-style coffee shop you’ll find here. Great coffee, excellent food, and a relaxed atmosphere that makes it easy to spend hours working or hanging out.

The owner is genuinely passionate and incredibly knowledgeable. Their flowers are treated the way a sommelier treats fine wine carefully selected, well explained, and always top quality.

A must-visit if you’re in Phuket.
Very good place to have a few beers and chill, Maa and Gik took great care of me and served me well. I would definitely visit again the next time I am in Phuket
